put.description: Updates an existing naming rule. Use isActive=false to deactivate without deleting.

parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Locale for localized response messages (for example: en, fr-FR, pseudo)

schema.description: Request to update a field rule (definition + metadata)

rule_type.description: Optional metadata. NOT updatable: if provided, must match the existing rule's type; the server rejects mismatches.

fieldset_id.description: New fieldset id. FIELD_DEFAULTS only; ignored / rejected for NAMING. Provided to recover a rule whose asset type's fieldset has been changed by an admin. Must match the asset type's current fieldset and must contain the rule's trigger_field.

definition.description: Rule definition. Shape must match the rule's stored type — for NAMING, supply expression_fields; for FIELD_DEFAULTS, supply actions. is_active.description: Whether the rule is active. Set to false to deactivate.

conditions.description: Conditions AST for a conditional-validation rule

root.description: Root node of the recursive conditions tree

project_id.description: Project this rule applies to; null for company-level rules

asset_type_id.description: Asset type this rule applies to. Populated for FIELD_DEFAULTS; null for NAMING.

fieldset_id.description: Fieldset scope. '-1' for Procore default fields, external configurable fieldset id for custom fields. Null for NAMING.

trigger_field.description: Field that triggers this rule (e.g. asset_code for NAMING, custom_field_1234 for FIELD_DEFAULTS)

fallback.description: For REF: fallback when field value is null or empty

digits.description: For SEQ: number of digits for padding (e.g. 3 -> 001)

start_value.description: For SEQ: optional starting sequence number

actions.description: Non-empty list of actions to apply. Must include exactly one SET_DEFAULT; SET_READ_ONLY is optional and appears at most once.

items.description: A single action inside a field rule definition

value.description: Action value. For SET_DEFAULT: matches the Asset custom_fields storage format (String/Number/Boolean for primitives, {id, name} for reference types). For SET_READ_ONLY: Boolean true/false.

data_type.description: FieldType key (required for SET_DEFAULT; null for SET_READ_ONLY)
